loadError.title: The commits could not be loaded

direction.oldestTopNewestBottom: Oldest commit at the top, newest at the bottom

check.noTarget: No commit remains above that this one could merge into.
check.empty: There are no commits to edit.
check.allDropped: At least one commit must stay – otherwise the branch would have no commits of its own.
check.topSquash: The topmost remaining commit cannot be squashed – no commit remains above it to merge into.
check.unchanged: Nothing changed yet. Reorder, or choose a different action for a commit.

refused.noCommonAncestor: This base does not fit the branch
refused.operationInProgress: An operation is still in progress

confirm.dropped_one: One commit leaves “{{branch}}” – its changes will no longer be in the branch.
confirm.dropped_other: {{count}} commits leave “{{branch}}” – their changes will no longer be in the branch.
confirm.pushed: The commits are already on a remote and will be rewritten: the branch will then differ from the remote, and the next push must be forced.
confirm.undo: You can take the rebase back afterwards with “Undo” in the toolbar.
confirm.dropTitle_one: Drop {{count}} commit and start the rebase?
confirm.dropTitle_other: Drop {{count}} commits and start the rebase?

interactive.reloadedBody: The branch changed while the plan was open. The list now shows the current state; previous changes to the plan have been discarded.
interactive.rewordBody: New message for {{sha}}. The content of the commit stays the same.
interactive.resultBody_one: {{count}} commit becomes one. Prefilled with the messages of all involved commits.
interactive.resultBody_other: {{count}} commits become one. Prefilled with the messages of all involved commits.
interactive.staleTitle: The branch has changed in the meantime
interactive.staleBody: Something happened on the branch since the plan was loaded, for example a commit in the terminal. The plan has been reloaded – check it and start again.
interactive.upToDateBody: The plan matches the current state of the branch.
interactive.rebaseFirstBody: “{{base}}” has moved on since the branch split off. Rebase it normally onto “{{base}}” first – then its commits can be reordered and edited here.
interactive.pushedTitle: These commits are already on a remote
interactive.pushedBody: The rebase rewrites them. The branch will then differ from the remote, and the next push must be forced (force push).
interactive.listLabel: Commits of the rebase, oldest at the top
interactive.keysHelp: Arrow keys select a commit. P picks, R rewords, S squashes, D drops. Alt with an arrow moves. Space opens the action choice, Enter edits the message.
interactive.resetTip: Discard all changes to the plan

squash.label: Squash
squash.tooFewBody: Select at least two consecutive commits in the graph with Shift or {{mod}}, then open the context menu.
squash.mergeTitle: A merge commit cannot be squashed
squash.mergeBody: The selection contains a merge commit. Squashing only works with a straight sequence of commits.
squash.gapBody: There are other commits between the selected ones. An interactive rebase can also squash scattered commits – there you can move them next to each other first.
squash.summaryEmpty: The summary must not be empty.
squash.operationRunning: Finish or abort the running operation first.
squash.confirmBodyBranch: At least one of these commits is already on a remote. Squashing rewrites them: “{{branch}}” will then differ from the remote, and the next push must be forced. You can take the squash back afterwards with “Undo” in the toolbar.
squash.confirmBody: At least one of these commits is already on a remote. Squashing rewrites them: the branch will then differ from the remote, and the next push must be forced. You can take the squash back afterwards with “Undo” in the toolbar.
squash.pushedTitle: At least one of these commits is already on a remote
squash.pushedBody: Squashing rewrites the history. The branch will then differ from the remote, and the next push must be forced (force push).
squash.direction: Oldest commit at the top – author and date of the oldest are kept
squash.listLabel: Commits being squashed, oldest at the top
squash.laterRebased: later commits of the branch are rebased

pick.noneBody: Select the commits you want to transfer in the graph, then open the context menu.
pick.orderOnto: Order of application onto {{target}} – top to bottom
pick.unborn: The repository has no commit yet that anything could be transferred onto.
pick.operationRunning: Finish or abort the running {{operation}} first.
pick.upToDateBody: The changes are already contained in {{target}}.
pick.listLabel: Commits for the cherry-pick, in order of application
pick.containedTip: The changes are already in {{target}}; the step will be skipped.
pick.keysHelp: Arrow keys select a commit, Space includes or skips it, Alt with an arrow moves it.
pick.footer: onto {{target}}; on a conflict, it continues in the local changes
